_comment: Figures are a measured run against this repo's own model at Bigquery & Dbt Cost Observability/powerbi/BigQuery dbt Cost Observability.SemanticModel, which was itself documented with this script - so every field already carries a comment and the run reports 240 replaced, 0 inserted. The README states how to reproduce it.

hero.name: hero
hero.title: Semantic Model Descriptions
hero.subtitle: Load field descriptions into a TMDL semantic model from a CSV, as the /// comments that surface as tooltips in Power BI Desktop.

banners.name: section-csv
banners.title: Build the CSV
banners.body: Four columns, and the table and field names have to match the model exactly. Getting them from the model itself beats typing them.

banners.name: section-run
banners.title: Run it, then reopen the model
banners.body: Descriptions land as /// comment lines above each declaration. Re-running replaces them rather than stacking them, so the script is safe to run repeatedly.

banners.name: section-reference
banners.title: Know how it can fail quietly
banners.body: It never errors on a field it cannot find. Everything that makes a row miss, and how to tell a miss from a match.

casts.name: cast-run
casts.caption: captured run against this repo's own semantic model, already fully documented

lines.t: # every field already carried a comment, so all {replaced} were replaced in place
